conflict.ctd: Simple Combat Bar is standing down because Carousel Combat Tracker (combat-tracker-dock) is also active. Both draw a turn-order bar across the top of the screen; disable one of them in Manage Modules.

enabled.name: Show the Combat Bar
enabled.hint: Show the turn-order bar across the top of the screen during combat. Only affects you.

portraitStyle.name: Portrait Style
portraitStyle.hint: How each combatant is drawn on the bar.

portraitSize.name: Portrait Size
portraitSize.hint: The largest a portrait is drawn, in pixels. With Fit to Width on, portraits shrink below this when the bar is crowded. Only affects you.

overflow.name: When the Bar Is Full
overflow.hint: What happens when there are more combatants than fit across the screen. Only affects you.

portraitImage.name: Portrait Image
portraitImage.hint: Use the actor's portrait art or the token's image.

nameVisibility.name: Combatant Names
nameVisibility.hint: When players see the names of combatants they don't own. The GM always sees names.

choices.token: When the token's name is shown on hover or always

hpVisibility.name: Hit Points
hpVisibility.hint: How much players see of the hit points of combatants they can't observe. Foundry doesn't send the hit points of unlinked tokens to players who can't observe them, so for those the bar shows how wounded they are from their Bloodied and Dead conditions instead.

choices.all: Everyone sees exact hit points (when Foundry shares them)
choices.owner: Others see only healthy / bloodied / badly wounded

damageFill.name: Fill Portraits With Damage
damageFill.hint: Portraits fill red from the top as hit points are lost. Follows the Hit Points setting: exact for those who may see hit points, in coarse steps for those who only see how wounded a combatant is.

hideEnemyInitiative.name: Hide Enemy Initiative
hideEnemyInitiative.hint: Players don't see initiative values for combatants they don't own.

hideUnseenFirstRound.name: Reveal Enemies as They Act
hideUnseenFirstRound.hint: In the first round, players only see a hostile or neutral combatant on the bar once it has taken its turn.

hideDefeated.name: Remove Defeated Combatants
hideDefeated.hint: Take defeated combatants off the bar instead of showing them greyed out.

groupTeams.name: Group Turns
groupTeams.hint: Like Baldur's Gate 3: allies or enemies next to each other in the order share one frame on the bar.

choices.visual: Shared frame, still one at a time

sidebarOnCombat.name: Sidebar When Combat Starts
sidebarOnCombat.hint: Collapse the sidebar when combat starts, to give the scene more room.

debug.name: Debug Logging
debug.hint: Write the bar's internal events to the browser console. Only affects you.
